scope: Read-only inspection of the local PHPUnit/Pest database boundary before deciding whether any executable test could run safely.

decision.reason: The configured test database is not distinct from the checkout's default database name, while the suites use database-refresh behavior and the supplied schema preparation command performs a wipe. The read-only audit cannot prove that running the suite would avoid changing or deleting checkout data.
decision.minimum_input: Provide or approve a separate disposable database/schema with credentials supplied only through secure runtime configuration, confirm it is not used by the development application, and authorise the test run against that isolated target.
decision.prohibited_shortcut: Do not run testing:prepare-schema, migrate:fresh, db:wipe or the test suite against the currently configured shared database name.

commands_executed: SHA-256 hashing of the inspected files
